result.requirement: The system shall automatically generate and present retention incentives to customers identified as high-risk for churn based on negative feedback or service deviations.
result.business_need: The business needs to proactively reduce customer attrition by offering targeted credits or offers immediately after detecting dissatisfaction signals.
functional_behaviour: The system shall analyze Feedback Records and Dispute Tickets to identify customers with negative sentiment or unresolved issues.
The system shall calculate a churn risk score for each identified customer based on the severity and frequency of their negative interactions.
The system shall automatically generate a retention offer containing a credit or discount code for customers exceeding the high-risk threshold.
The system shall deliver the generated retention offer to the Customer via their registered contact channels.
The system shall log the delivery and acceptance status of the retention offer in the Customer Profile.
The system shall prevent the generation of new retention offers for the same customer until the current offer is redeemed or expires.
related_information_requirements: Qualitative ratings and comments regarding product quality and agent behavior
Structured records of deviations such as damaged goods or failed deliveries
Customer contact details including email and phone number
Historical interaction data to assess churn risk trends
business_rules: A retention offer must only be generated if the customer has at least one negative Feedback Record or an open Dispute Ticket.
The system must not generate a new retention offer for a customer if a valid offer is already active or pending redemption.
Retention offers must be automatically invalidated if the associated Dispute Ticket is resolved without a negative outcome.
The system must capture the specific reason code from the Feedback Record to determine the type of incentive offered.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer submits a Feedback Record with a rating of 1 star and a comment about damaged goods.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes this feedback and identifies the customer as high-risk for churn.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system automatically generates and sends a retention offer with a credit to the customer's registered email.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer has an active retention offer pending redemption in their profile.
acceptance_criteria.when: The customer submits a new Feedback Record indicating dissatisfaction with a recent order.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system does not generate a new retention offer and logs the event as 'Offer Active' in the Customer Profile.
